title: Pitches from women that reference the use of past loans to maintain their business tend to accelerate funding.
Providing specific geographic locations or settlement names may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Explicit thank yous to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Describing oneself as a hardworking entrepreneur may predict slower funding for women.
Mentioning a good credit history may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Focusing on business sustainability or progress may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Female borrowers who mention children's education or food security fund faster.
Pitches from women requesting smaller loan amounts in local currency tend to accelerate funding speed.
Specifying the gender of children may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide detailed personal backstories fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific local currency amounts or loan counts fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention building or expanding their business to secure their family fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of years the business has operated fund faster.
